import unittest
import pytest
from conftest import trace


@pytest.fixture
def external_resource(request):
    trace("external-resource-setup", instance=request.instance is not None)
    request.instance.injected = 7
    yield
    trace("external-resource-teardown")


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("external_resource")
class FixtureCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_usefixtures(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.injected, 7)
        trace("usefixtures-body")


class UnsupportedMethodInjection(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_requires_fixture_argument(self, external_resource):
        trace("must-not-inject-arguments")


class SubtestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.addCleanup(trace, "subtest-cleanup")

    def tearDown(self):
        trace("subtest-tearDown")

    def test_subtests(self):
        for value in (0, 1, 2, 3):
            with self.subTest("group", value=value):
                trace("subtest-body", value=value)
                if value == 1:
                    self.fail("subtest-failure")
                if value == 2:
                    self.skipTest("subtest-skip")
                if value == 3:
                    raise ValueError("subtest-error")
        trace("after-subtests")
